winCondition: Cooperative scenario: investigators advance the Act deck before the Agenda deck's doom runs out; the scenario ends with a resolution (outcome varies by scenario and campaign choices). No points; XP and trauma carry into the campaign log.

endCondition.description: A scenario resolution is reached (act advances to completion, agenda completes, or all investigators eliminated)

notes: family: coop. Not verified against the official rulebook (could not download). Resolutions are scenario-specific and not modelled; losing still grants experience.
